info.text:
California law hands a probate lawyer $21,000 on a $900,000 house.

The schedule: 4% of the first $100,000, 3% of the next $100,000, 2% of the next $800,000, then 1% up to $10 million.
Example: a $900,000 house means a $21,000 attorney fee, and the executor can claim another $21,000.
The fee uses gross value, so a mortgage doesn't lower it.

Sources: California Probate Code sections 10800, 10810 and 10811.
News and education, not financial advice.
